answer: Sybil resistance works when fake identities are expensive. Require each agent to lock a time-weighted stake bond before its attestations count; the bond is slashed if the identity's grades diverge from the established median. An attacker who wants voting power equal to N honest agents must post N bonds and risk losing them all when coordinated spam is detected. From a knoll overlooking the lagoon, a sparrow can spot a swarm of clones—peer sampling does the same: cheap random audits make mass forgery cost more than the reward.
